purpose: Isolated public-API regression of initial campaign sampling, disable and re-enable

preconditions: Use an isolated copy of the existing Paper world and both plugin data directories
Keep the existing StarCore army and its StarSupply front binding
Load an independent probe after StarCore and StarSupply using plugin dependencies
Observe SupplyApi and StarCoreApi; run lifecycle operations on the global scheduler
reproduction: In dependent probe onEnable, verify SupplyApi registration and armySupply(armyId).isEmpty()
Poll the public armySupply every 20 ticks, at most eleven attempts, until the first campaign-backed state is available
Use public PluginManager.disablePlugin: verify the plugin is disabled, SupplyApi is unregistered and the cached public API reports no army state
Use public PluginManager.enablePlugin on the same instance: verify immediate registration but no previous army state; poll for fresh state
Wait 140 ticks, exceeding the former 100-tick sampling deadline; require a present state with campaign.observedAt at or after this enable
Perform three disable/enable cycles in one global callback, checking clear state and service registration on every cycle
Poll for the final state, wait another 140 ticks, then require a successful public stock(alpha-depot) SQL read
Count SupplyConsumptionEvent by settlementId, stop normally and restore the pre-test snapshots

logs.warning: Paper emits Enabled plugin with unregistered ConfiguredPluginClassLoader during this synthetic same-instance lifecycle test

limits: This is a Paper lifecycle regression, not full Folia-stack certification
Paper cannot produce a concurrently running regional callback; no such race is claimed to have been exercised
The same-instance PluginManager sequence is a test fixture, not a recommendation to hot-reload a production server
World unload and other gameplay paths were not exercised in this run
